facts.text: The STAC Pledge awards full-time incoming first-year students at least $50,000 in scholarships and grants over four years ($12,500 annually) with no income limits.

sources.title: St. Thomas Aquinas Pledge - St. Thomas Aquinas College
sources.quote: The scholarship – $12,500 a year for four years or $50,000 total – automatically renews each year for a total of four years. There is no income requirement.
